Farmer leader Balbir Singh Rajewal, without directly naming Sarwan Singh Pandher, levelled serious allegations against him. Rajewal alleged that Pandher harmed the Delhi farmers' protest and claimed that certain actions affected the movement. He also referred to the Red Fort march incident.Sarwan Singh Pandher rejected the allegations and demanded evidence, saying that either facts should be presented or an apology should be issued. Pandher claimed that similar allegations had been made against him earlier without any basis. The disagreement between the farmer leaders has sparked a new debate.
